stem:
Meena wants to make a working battery for her torch using two cells in a holder at home.
Which arrangement of the two cells will make the torch light up?

options.text: the positive terminal of the first cell touching the positive terminal of the second cell
the positive terminal of the first cell touching the negative terminal of the second cell
both cells placed with their positive terminals facing the same end of the holder
any arrangement, since two cells anywhere in the holder will make a battery

teacher.key_rationale: A working battery requires the positive terminal of one cell to be connected to the negative terminal of the next, so B is correct. A and C trap students who think like terminals or uniform direction is correct; D traps students who think terminal order does not matter.
